text:
Ana: Heads up — code freeze is at 18:00 UTC today for the v1.12 cutoff. If you have a docs-only bump that needs an exception, drop the PR link + owner here and we'll triage quickly.

release-bot: Reminder: release freeze window starts 2025-05-15T18:00:00Z. Exceptions require: release lead approval + a canary/smoke run. Submit requests in #eng-releases.

Maria: Quick one — tiny docs typo fix in PR https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/4123. Docs-only, no code changes. Can I get an exception to merge? I can run a canary now.

Ana: Please add a changelog line and the label `changelog/docs`. Also paste the canary link when it's done.

Maria: Done — changelog line added, label applied. Canary triggered: https://ci.redwood/runs/987-smoke (smoke -> green). :white_check_mark:

Sam: Looks fine to me — docs-only and smoke passed. @Ana tagging for release lead ok.

Kofi: Release lead here. Reviewed PR 4123; docs-only, no runtime changes. Canary green. Approving exception. Please squash into one commit before merging.

Maria: Thanks @Kofi. I'll squash now. If we're still frozen at merge time I'll wait for explicit go-ahead, otherwise I'll merge immediately after checks.

Ana: Approved. We'll allow a post-cutoff merge for docs-only patches provided CI stays green and there are no dependency changes. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Exception recorded: PR 4123 — approved by Kofi, Ana. Audit ID: EXC-20250515-77. Note: merges during freeze are logged for post-release review.

Jin: Quick question — do docs-only merges require a buildstamp bump or anything for the release notes?

Ana: No buildstamp needed for docs-only. Just ensure changelog entry exists and leave a note in the release notes doc if it's user-facing.

Maria: Merged at 18:02 UTC (after confirming CI). Thanks all for the quick turnaround.

Sam: Thanks! Appreciated the quick canary run.

Ana: Closing thread — saved exception in the freeze log. If anyone has follow-ups ping me directly.
